none: PAS HESH-AA6265: Roman Coin: Radiate (barbarous) Tetricus I
contea di ritrovamento: Shropshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Barbarous radiate of Tetricus I: reverse type Goddess (most likely Pax), draped, standing left, holding olive-branch or torch in right hand and sceptre in left hand (AD 271-274). Reece Period: 13. Obverse description: Bust of Tetricus I, radiate, draped, right. Obverse inscription: IMP TETRIC[VS AVG].
